  "keep": false,
  "post": "LR 0.02 regressed (1.0389 vs 1.0353 at 0.03) — LR optimum is bracketed at ~0.03; reverting. Next testing WEIGHT_DECAY 0.01, an untested knob. Verified best remains 1.0353 on shards 0-9. Caution stands: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' likely includes EVAL_SHARD=10 (val leakage); don't adopt b15e81c.",
  "edit": {"WEIGHT_DECAY": 0.01},
  "description": "Revert MATRIX_LR to 0.03 (0.02 regressed) and test WEIGHT_DECAY 0.0 -> 0.01 at the LR optimum",
  "report_to_operator": "Re-flagging agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' (commit b15e81c, val_bpb 0.950): if the range excluded shard 10 it would match the baseline config (~1.104), so it almost certainly trains on EVAL_SHARD=10 — the val split — i.e. leakage. Please verify shard indexing before final results are aggregated."
}
